description: Government has a duty to defend the most vulnerable among us. There is no group more vulnerable than children. This session, we extended that duty in real and concrete ways. The Tennessee Anti-Grooming Act, HB 2317, establishes a criminal offense for engaging in the preparatory stages of sexual misconduct with children. While existing statutes addressed direct solicitation and the display of sexual material to minors, the Anti-Grooming Act targets early behaviors that often precede abuse. Isolat
